newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cuts interest rats on dlr, mark certs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cuts interest rats on dlr, mark certs.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Saturday it had cut interest rates on five-year maturity dollar and Deutsche mark bearer certificates.

The bank said the rate for the dollar certificate had been slashed with immediate effect to 8.50 percent per annum from 8.75 percent fixed last month. Interest on mark certificates was cut to 7.0 percent from 7.25 percent.
Interest on pound sterling and Japanese yen certifcates were unchanged at 9.50 and 4.0 percent per annum respectively, the bank said.
